title: Mixed-scope commit aad35c1 contains JMAP-x2gd.102 work plus unrelated pre-existing metadata-server test additions
description:
Commit aad35c1646ef8e0d784aeaa846cc3e3c75945c19 ('test(chat-server): canary for duplicate-Direct cleanup destroy redaction') accidentally included 176 lines of unrelated test additions to crate-jmap-metadata-server/tests/metadata_tests.rs alongside the in-scope chat-server changes.

The metadata_tests.rs changes were sitting unstaged in the working tree at the start of the /do-beads session for JMAP-x2gd.102. Despite explicit 'git add' of only the chat-server files, the metadata file was already in the staging area from a prior session and got swept into the commit.

The metadata content appears to be a 'Metadata/queryChanges standard cycle (bd:JMAP-ayoz.6.4)' end-to-end test addition — substantial, well-formed, and clearly intentional work that just wasn't committed at the time.

Workspace AGENTS.md 'Git Safety Protocol' allows commit --amend only when:
  (1) the user explicitly requests amend [FALSE here], OR
  (2) hooks auto-modified files needing inclusion [N/A]
…AND (3) the commit was created in this conversation [TRUE], AND (4) the commit has not been pushed [TRUE].

Since (1) is not satisfied and 'git reset *' is denied by the bd-spin permission overlay, autonomous splitting is blocked. Filing this as a 'human' bead so the user can either:
  - Authorize an amend/split (preferred — keeps the metadata work as its own commit with its own message and bd-reference)
  - Leave the mixed commit in place and file a follow-up commit-message-correction (cosmetic only; the code is fine)
  - Confirm the metadata-tests work was intentionally being held back; revert it from aad35c1 and re-land in a fresh commit

Recommendation: amend aad35c1 to drop the metadata_tests.rs hunk, then 'git add crate-jmap-metadata-server/tests/metadata_tests.rs && git commit' it under whatever bead-ref the metadata work belongs to (likely bd:JMAP-ayoz.6 or a child). I will leave the metadata_tests.rs changes in the working tree post-amend so the human can decide whether to commit them.

Acceptance: aad35c1's diff is restricted to chat-server, and the metadata_tests.rs work lives in its own commit with appropriate bd reference. No data loss.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (moot, skeptic-confirmed): aad35c16 is on origin/main with 642 commits on top, so it cannot be split without a force-push. The metadata_tests.rs content it carried was deleted when metadata-server was rewritten for draft-02 in b34a07bf, so crate-jmap-metadata-server/tests no longer exists.
